description: Validate that an agent given the scaffold-gen SKILL.md correctly bootstraps a new project via the real `scafgen new` CLI (non-interactively, correct framework token, no hang), versus a baseline agent without the skill.

evals.name: fastapi-cn
evals.prompt: 帮我起一个 fastapi 项目，叫 orderapi，监听 8080
evals.expected_output: Agent runs `scafgen new orderapi --language python --framework fastapi --port 8080 ...` with all flags non-interactively; generated project has config.toml + app/routes/ + main.py.
assertions: Used the scafgen tool (did not hand-roll the project from scratch)
Ran `scafgen new` non-interactively with --language and --framework flags (no hang)
Chose the correct framework token `fastapi`
Passed port 8080 through to config
Generated FastAPI key files: config.toml + app/routes/ + main.py
Project named orderapi

evals.name: vue3-vague
evals.prompt: I want to start a new Vue3 frontend for our admin dashboard
evals.expected_output: Agent confirms a name + sensible defaults, then runs `scafgen new <name> --language typescript --framework vue3 ...` non-interactively; generated project has .env + vite.config.ts + src/.
assertions: Used the scafgen tool (did not hand-roll the project from scratch)
Ran `scafgen new` non-interactively with --language and --framework flags (no hang)
Chose the correct framework token `vue3`
Picked/confirmed a sensible project name despite the vague prompt
Generated Vue3 key files: .env (or .env.example) + vite.config.ts + src/

evals.name: mcp-go
evals.prompt: set up a new Go MCP server project called toolhub
evals.expected_output: Agent runs `scafgen new toolhub --language go --framework mcp-server ...` non-interactively; generated project has config.toml + proto/ + internal/ + cmd/server.
assertions: Used the scafgen tool (did not hand-roll the project from scratch)
Ran `scafgen new` non-interactively with --language and --framework flags (no hang)
Chose the correct framework token `mcp-server` (not gin / not a guessed token)
Generated MCP key files: config.toml + proto/ + internal/ + cmd/server
Project named toolhub

evals.name: rust-cli
evals.prompt: create a new rust CLI tool named logparse
evals.expected_output: Agent runs `scafgen new logparse --language rust ...` non-interactively (pure-language; MUST also pass --proto-gen/--error-gen or it hangs); generated project has Cargo.toml + src/main.rs.
assertions: Used the scafgen tool (did not fall back to plain `cargo new`)
Ran `scafgen new` for Rust pure-language and ultimately succeeded (no terminal hang)
Passed the Rust-specific flags --proto-gen and --error-gen (required non-interactively)
First scafgen invocation did NOT hang on a missing flag
Generated Rust key files: Cargo.toml + src/main.rs
Project named logparse
